To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the semileptonic decay form factors of the Λb baryon are calculated within the quark model without employing the nonrelativistic or the heavy quark expansions, that the branching fraction of Λb → Λc lνl decays is predicted, that the ratio of the heavy-to-heavy and heavy-to-light branching fractions is calculated from the LHCb data, and that the ratio of CKM matrix elements |V ub|/|V cb| is determined from the LHC
the semileptonic decaying of the Λb baryons in a relativistic quark-diquak approach is consistent with the experimental data on branching fractions and the CKM matrix element ratio |Vub|2/|Vcb|2.

the relativistic quasipotentional quark model based approach is able to reproduce the available experimental data on the semileptonic decaying of the Λb baryon and the model provides a reliable tool for the prediction of the branching fractions for these decays.

The main takeaway from our work is that
in the relativistic model based on the relativistic quasipotentials the heavy-to-light decays of Λb baryons can be treated on equal footing with the heavy-to-heavy decays.
the relativistic quasipotetial model provides an accurate and reliable description of the heavy-to-heavy and heavy-to-light semileptonic decaying baryons.
